item.title: Workplace Survival Guide: Gilding Turds, Passing the Buck, and Emergency Tasks
item.description: Learn about the three-piece set of rushed operations in big companies: gilding turds, passing the buck, and emergency tasks. Discover how some people thrive without doing real work, and get practical advice for recognizing and avoiding these toxic workplace behaviors.
